verdict.rationale: Cake explicitly supports modeling a raise (SAFEs/Convertible Notes) and dilution impact, has a full contract editor for SAFEs/Convertibles/Options that can be customized with an attorney, and offers investor communication/e-signing workflows, and scenarios live in a shared cap table viewable by counsel/investors via portals. However, there's no explicit mention of an option pool top-up step within round modeling or dedicated 'pro-forma ownership' scenario comparison/export feature, and no evidence of a sandboxed 'what-if' scenario mode distinct from the live cap table. Missing for 10: explicit option pool top-up modeling in the raise workflow, dedicated pro-forma/what-if scenario comparison tooling, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the round-modeling accuracy.
